name: shortcode-smoke-tests
description: Build-output assertion suite for the five shortcode modules that ship no suite of their own: arxiv-paper, callout, github-repo, hf-space and youtube-embed. Not a Hugo module: this directory holds one fixture that imports all five, invokes each once, and asserts what they emit. It carries no dependencies -- node --test and node:assert are enough -- so it needs no npm install of its own.
